subject.title: Request: Add Discord reaction event support to Hooks system

question: Should OpenClaw add generic observation-only reaction_added/reaction_removed hooks to the public plugin API now, and should the first implementation be Discord-only or part of a broader non-message event contract?
rationale: Source inspection proves the gap, but hook names, payload shape, lazy enrichment, and cross-channel scope are durable public API choices that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Adopt generic reaction hooks
options.body: Add observation-only reaction_added/reaction_removed hooks with a portable payload and wire Discord first without changing wake or agent-turn behavior.

options.title: Defer to broader event API
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/100447 as the API design umbrella and keep this issue as the Discord acceptance case.

options.title: Ship Discord-only hook
options.body: Expose a narrowly scoped Discord reaction hook sooner, accepting a later compatibility pass if the generic channel event API differs.

recommendation.title: Adopt generic reaction hooks
recommendation.body: Add observation-only reaction_added/reaction_removed hooks with a portable payload and wire Discord first without changing wake or agent-turn behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The requested change is primarily a plugin hook contract decision, and this person has the strongest observed history on the current hook contract split and runner types.
